response.sql: WITH matched_orders AS (SELECT COALESCE(o.timespan, 'NULL') AS timespan_bucket FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault), bucket_counts AS (SELECT timespan_bucket, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_count FROM matched_orders GROUP BY timespan_bucket), bucket_shares AS (SELECT bucket_count, bucket_count * 1.0 / total_count AS bucket_share, AVG(bucket_count * 1.0 / total_count) OVER () AS avg_share FROM bucket_counts), filtered_buckets AS (SELECT bucket_count, bucket_share, avg_share FROM bucket_shares WHERE bucket_share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(bucket_count) AS total_count, AVG(bucket_share) AS avg_share, AVG(bucket_share - avg_share) AS avg_above_average FROM filtered_buckets;
